# Cargo Weight, Profit/kg and Cargo Optimizer Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Add item weight, profit-per-kg, and an automatic "Cargo Planner"
(greedy multi-strategy allocator) to the Black Market Flip Scanner, so users
can see what to physically carry on a transport run to Caerleon.

**Architecture:** A new static `item_weights.json` (generated by a
reproducible script from `ao-bin-dumps/items.xml`) feeds weight into the
existing price-calculation pipeline. A new `compute_city_opportunities`
function (sibling to the existing `compute_opportunities`) computes
opportunities for one specific origin city instead of the globally-cheapest
city, fixing a conceptual bug a naive post-filter would introduce. A new
`cargo_optimizer.py` module runs three greedy allocation strategies
(profit-per-kg, ROI, unit profit) under weight+budget constraints and returns
the best of the three ("Best-of-Greedy") — deliberately not an exact
knapsack solve, since the AODP price API doesn't expose order-book depth
precise enough to justify one. A new `/api/cargo-plan` endpoint and a new
"Planejador de Carga" panel in the frontend expose this.

**Tech Stack:** Python, FastAPI, httpx (already in use); vanilla JS (no new
frontend dependency).

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-18-cargo-weight-and-optimizer-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- Weight source: `ao-bin-dumps/items.xml`, attribute `weight="X.X"` keyed by
  `uniquename` — fetched only by the offline generation script, never at
  runtime.
- `item_weights.json` keys are **base item ids without the `@N` enchantment
  suffix** — weight doesn't vary by enchantment (verified: enchanted
  variants have no separate XML entry).
- Cargo Planner origin cities are the 5 Royal Cities **excluding Caerleon**:
  `Bridgewatch, Lymhurst, Martlock, Thetford, FortSterling`.
- No exact knapsack optimization — Best-of-Greedy across 3 strategies
  (`profit_per_kg`, `roi` i.e. `margin_pct`, `profit`), each respecting
  weight, budget, and `max_qty_per_item` simultaneously.
- Internal cargo allocation arithmetic uses integer grams and integer
  silver to avoid float drift; API responses convert weight back to float
  kg for display.
- `max_qty_per_item` is an exposure cap, not a detected stock quantity —
  the AODP price API doesn't expose order-book depth.
- Existing 300s AODP price cache (keyed by `(server, tuple(item_ids))`, and
  `item_ids` is always the full `items.json` list) already covers repeated
  Cargo Planner parameter tweaks — no new cache layer.
- `GET /api/cargo-plan` validates `city` via a FastAPI `Enum` (422 on
  invalid) and `budget`/`available_weight`/`max_qty_per_item` via FastAPI
  `Query(..., gt=0)` (422 on invalid) — no manual validation code.

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the generation script**

```python
# scripts/generate_item_weights.py
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import httpx

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.parent
ITEMS_XML_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ao-data/ao-bin-dumps/master/items.xml"


def base_item_id(item_id):
    return item_id.split("@")[0]


def main():
    items = json.loads((BASE_DIR / "items.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    base_ids = sorted({base_item_id(item["id"]) for item in items})

    print(f"Downloading {ITEMS_XML_URL} ...", file=sys.stderr)
    response = httpx.get(ITEMS_XML_URL, timeout=60.0)
    response.raise_for_status()
    xml_content = response.text

    weights = {}
    for base_id in base_ids:
        pattern = rf'uniquename="{re.escape(base_id)}"[^>]*weight="([\d.]+)"'
        match = re.search(pattern, xml_content)
        if not match:
            raise SystemExit(f"Weight not found for {base_id}")
        weights[base_id] = float(match.group(1))

    (BASE_DIR / "item_weights.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(weights, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print(f"Wrote {len(weights)} weights to item_weights.json")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
# flip_calculator.py
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from aodp_client import BLACK_MARKET_CITY, CITIES

CITY_LOCATIONS = set(CITIES)


def _parse_date(date_str):
    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(date_str)
    if dt.tzinfo is None:
        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return dt


def _age_minutes(date_str, now):
    return (now - _parse_date(date_str)).total_seconds() / 60


def _base_item_id(item_id):
    return item_id.split("@")[0]


def _build_opportunity(item_id, quality, city_rows, bm_rows, item_names, item_weights, tax_pct, max_age_min, now):
    if not city_rows or not bm_rows:
        return None

    best_city_row = min(city_rows, key=lambda r: r["sell_price_min"])
    best_bm_row = max(bm_rows, key=lambda r: r["buy_price_max"])

    city_age = _age_minutes(best_city_row["sell_price_min_date"], now)
    bm_age = _age_minutes(best_bm_row["buy_price_max_date"], now)
    if city_age > max_age_min or bm_age > max_age_min:
        return None

    city_price = best_city_row["sell_price_min"]
    bm_price = best_bm_row["buy_price_max"]
    profit = bm_price * (1 - tax_pct / 100) - city_price
    margin_pct = (profit / city_price) * 100 if city_price else 0

    weight = item_weights.get(_base_item_id(item_id)) if item_weights else None
    profit_per_kg = round(profit / weight, 2) if weight else None

    return {
        "item_id": item_id,
        "item_name": item_names.get(item_id, item_id),
        "quality": quality,
        "source_city": best_city_row["city"],
        "city_price": city_price,
        "city_price_age_min": round(city_age, 1),
        "bm_price": bm_price,
        "bm_price_age_min": round(bm_age, 1),
        "tax_pct": tax_pct,
        "profit": round(profit, 2),
        "margin_pct": round(margin_pct, 2),
        "weight": weight,
        "profit_per_kg": profit_per_kg,
    }


def _group_by_item_and_quality(raw_prices):
    grouped = {}
    for row in raw_prices:
        key = (row["item_id"], row["quality"])
        grouped.setdefault(key, []).append(row)
    return grouped


def compute_opportunities(raw_prices, item_names, tax_pct, max_age_min, item_weights=None, now=None):
    if now is None:
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    opportunities = []
    for (item_id, quality), rows in _group_by_item_and_quality(raw_prices).items():
        city_rows = [r for r in rows if r["city"] in CITY_LOCATIONS and r["sell_price_min"] > 0]
        bm_rows = [r for r in rows if r["city"] == BLACK_MARKET_CITY and r["buy_price_max"] > 0]
        opp = _build_opportunity(item_id, quality, city_rows, bm_rows, item_names, item_weights, tax_pct, max_age_min, now)
        if opp:
            opportunities.append(opp)

    opportunities.sort(key=lambda o: o["profit"], reverse=True)
    return opportunities


def compute_city_opportunities(raw_prices, item_names, tax_pct, max_age_min, origin_city, item_weights=None, now=None):
    if now is None:
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    opportunities = []
    for (item_id, quality), rows in _group_by_item_and_quality(raw_prices).items():
        city_rows = [r for r in rows if r["city"] == origin_city and r["sell_price_min"] > 0]
        bm_rows = [r for r in rows if r["city"] == BLACK_MARKET_CITY and r["buy_price_max"] > 0]
        opp = _build_opportunity(item_id, quality, city_rows, bm_rows, item_names, item_weights, tax_pct, max_age_min, now)
        if opp:
            opportunities.append(opp)

    opportunities.sort(key=lambda o: o["profit"], reverse=True)
    return opportunities
```

```python
# tests/test_cargo_optimizer.py
from cargo_optimizer import optimize_cargo


def _opp(item_id, city_price, bm_price, profit, margin_pct, weight, profit_per_kg,
         quality=1, item_name=None, city_age=5.0, bm_age=5.0):
    return {
        "item_id": item_id,
        "item_name": item_name or item_id,
        "quality": quality,
        "city_price": city_price,
        "bm_price": bm_price,
        "profit": profit,
        "margin_pct": margin_pct,
        "weight": weight,
        "profit_per_kg": profit_per_kg,
        "city_price_age_min": city_age,
        "bm_price_age_min": bm_age,
    }


def test_never_exceeds_available_weight():
    opps = [_opp("A", 1000, 1500, 500, 50.0, 10.0, 50.0)]
    plan = optimize_cargo(opps, budget=1_000_000, available_weight=25, max_qty_per_item=10)
    assert plan["totals"]["weight_used"] <= 25


def test_never_exceeds_budget():
    opps = [_opp("A", 1000, 1500, 500, 50.0, 1.0, 500.0)]
    plan = optimize_cargo(opps, budget=2500, available_weight=1000, max_qty_per_item=10)
    assert plan["totals"]["capital_used"] <= 2500


def test_respects_max_qty_per_item():
    opps = [_opp("A", 100, 200, 100, 100.0, 1.0, 100.0)]
    plan = optimize_cargo(opps, budget=1_000_000, available_weight=1000, max_qty_per_item=3)
    assert plan["items"][0]["quantity"] == 3


def test_weight_constrained_case_prefers_profit_per_kg_strategy():
    # A is weight-efficient (high profit_per_kg) but low ROI; B is the opposite.
    # With very tight weight and huge budget, packing by profit_per_kg wins.
    opps = [
        _opp("A", 100, 300, 200, 200.0, 1.0, 200.0),   # profit/kg = 200, roi = 200%
        _opp("B", 100, 150, 50, 50.0, 10.0, 5.0),      # profit/kg = 5, roi = 50%
    ]
    plan = optimize_cargo(opps, budget=1_000_000, available_weight=10, max_qty_per_item=10)
    assert plan["totals"]["strategy_used"] == "profit_per_kg"
    assert plan["items"][0]["item_id"] == "A"


def test_budget_constrained_case_can_beat_profit_per_kg_alone():
    # A has the best profit_per_kg but is very expensive per unit; B is cheap
    # with decent ROI. With a small budget and huge weight capacity, filling
    # with many B's beats buying one A.
    opps = [
        _opp("A", 900_000, 1_000_000, 100_000, 11.1, 1.0, 100_000.0),
        _opp("B", 1_000, 1_400, 400, 40.0, 5.0, 80.0),
    ]
    plan = optimize_cargo(opps, budget=10_000, available_weight=1000, max_qty_per_item=10)
    assert plan["totals"]["strategy_used"] != "profit_per_kg"
    assert plan["items"][0]["item_id"] == "B"
    assert plan["totals"]["profit"] > 0


def test_exact_weight_boundary_fits_without_rounding_error():
    opps = [_opp("A", 100, 200, 100, 100.0, 2.5, 40.0)]
    plan = optimize_cargo(opps, budget=1_000_000, available_weight=25.0, max_qty_per_item=10)
    # 25.0 / 2.5 = exactly 10 units
    assert plan["items"][0]["quantity"] == 10
    assert plan["totals"]["weight_used"] == 25.0


def test_item_with_missing_weight_is_skipped_safely():
    opps = [_opp("A", 100, 200, 100, 100.0, None, None)]
    plan = optimize_cargo(opps, budget=1_000_000, available_weight=1000, max_qty_per_item=10)
    assert plan["items"] == []
    assert plan["totals"]["profit"] == 0


def test_totals_match_sum_of_items_exactly():
    opps = [
        _opp("A", 1000, 1500, 500, 50.0, 5.0, 100.0),
        _opp("B", 2000, 2600, 600, 30.0, 8.0, 75.0),
    ]
    plan = optimize_cargo(opps, budget=1_000_000, available_weight=1000, max_qty_per_item=3)
    expected_cost = sum(i["total_cost"] for i in plan["items"])
    expected_weight = round(sum(i["total_weight"] for i in plan["items"]), 2)
    assert plan["totals"]["capital_used"] == expected_cost
    assert plan["totals"]["weight_used"] == expected_weight


def test_binding_constraint_none_when_ran_out_of_candidates():
    opps = [_opp("A", 100, 200, 100, 100.0, 1.0, 100.0)]
    plan = optimize_cargo(opps, budget=1_000_000, available_weight=1000, max_qty_per_item=1)
    assert plan["totals"]["binding_constraint"] == "none"


def test_empty_opportunities_returns_zeroed_totals():
    plan = optimize_cargo([], budget=100_000, available_weight=500, max_qty_per_item=5)
    assert plan["items"] == []
    assert plan["totals"]["capital_used"] == 0
    assert plan["totals"]["capital_remaining"] == 100_000
    assert plan["totals"]["weight_remaining"] == 500
    assert plan["totals"]["binding_constraint"] == "none"
    assert plan["totals"]["strategy_used"] is None
```

```python
# cargo_optimizer.py
STRATEGY_SORT_KEYS = {
    "profit_per_kg": "profit_per_kg",
    "roi": "margin_pct",
    "profit": "profit",
}


def _allocate_greedy(opportunities, budget, available_weight_g, max_qty_per_item, sort_key):
    candidates = sorted(
        (o for o in opportunities if o.get("weight")),
        key=lambda o: o[sort_key],
        reverse=True,
    )

    remaining_budget = budget
    remaining_weight_g = available_weight_g
    items = []

    for opp in candidates:
        unit_cost = opp["city_price"]
        unit_weight_g = round(opp["weight"] * 1000)
        if unit_cost <= 0 or unit_weight_g <= 0:
            continue

        max_by_budget = remaining_budget // unit_cost
        max_by_weight = remaining_weight_g // unit_weight_g
        quantity = min(max_qty_per_item, max_by_budget, max_by_weight)

        if quantity <= 0:
            continue

        total_cost = quantity * unit_cost
        total_weight_g = quantity * unit_weight_g

        items.append({
            "item_id": opp["item_id"],
            "item_name": opp["item_name"],
            "quality": opp["quality"],
            "quantity": quantity,
            "unit_cost": unit_cost,
            "total_cost": total_cost,
            "bm_unit_price": opp["bm_price"],
            "unit_weight": opp["weight"],
            "total_weight": round(total_weight_g / 1000, 2),
            "unit_profit": opp["profit"],
            "total_profit": round(opp["profit"] * quantity, 2),
            "roi_pct": opp["margin_pct"],
            "profit_per_kg": opp["profit_per_kg"],
            "source_age_min": opp["city_price_age_min"],
            "bm_age_min": opp["bm_price_age_min"],
        })

        remaining_budget -= total_cost
        remaining_weight_g -= total_weight_g

    capital_used = budget - remaining_budget
    weight_used_g = available_weight_g - remaining_weight_g
    profit = round(sum(i["total_profit"] for i in items), 2)

    return {
        "items": items,
        "capital_used": capital_used,
        "capital_remaining": remaining_budget,
        "weight_used_g": weight_used_g,
        "weight_remaining_g": remaining_weight_g,
        "profit": profit,
    }


def _binding_constraint(budget_utilization_pct, weight_utilization_pct):
    if budget_utilization_pct < 90 and weight_utilization_pct < 90:
        return "none"
    if abs(budget_utilization_pct - weight_utilization_pct) <= 2:
        return "both"
    return "weight" if weight_utilization_pct > budget_utilization_pct else "capital"


def optimize_cargo(opportunities, budget, available_weight, max_qty_per_item=5):
    available_weight_g = round(available_weight * 1000)

    plans = {
        name: _allocate_greedy(opportunities, budget, available_weight_g, max_qty_per_item, sort_key)
        for name, sort_key in STRATEGY_SORT_KEYS.items()
    }

    best_strategy = max(plans, key=lambda name: plans[name]["profit"])
    best = plans[best_strategy]
    has_items = bool(best["items"])

    weight_used = round(best["weight_used_g"] / 1000, 2)
    weight_remaining = round(best["weight_remaining_g"] / 1000, 2)
    budget_utilization_pct = round(best["capital_used"] / budget * 100, 1) if budget else 0
    weight_utilization_pct = round(best["weight_used_g"] / available_weight_g * 100, 1) if available_weight_g else 0

    return {
        "items": best["items"],
        "totals": {
            "capital_used": best["capital_used"],
            "capital_remaining": best["capital_remaining"],
            "weight_used": weight_used,
            "weight_remaining": weight_remaining,
            "budget_utilization_pct": budget_utilization_pct,
            "weight_utilization_pct": weight_utilization_pct,
            "profit": best["profit"],
            "roi_pct": round(best["profit"] / best["capital_used"] * 100, 2) if best["capital_used"] else 0,
            "binding_constraint": _binding_constraint(budget_utilization_pct, weight_utilization_pct) if has_items else "none",
            "strategy_used": best_strategy if has_items else None,
        },
    }
```

```python
# main.py
import json
from enum import Enum
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import FastAPI, Query
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles

from aodp_client import CITIES, AodpFetchError, fetch_prices
from cargo_optimizer import optimize_cargo
from flip_calculator import compute_city_opportunities, compute_opportunities

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).parent
ITEMS = json.loads((BASE_DIR / "items.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
ITEM_IDS = [item["id"] for item in ITEMS]
ITEM_NAMES = {item["id"]: item["name"] for item in ITEMS}
ITEM_WEIGHTS = json.loads((BASE_DIR / "item_weights.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

TransportOrigin = Enum(
    "TransportOrigin",
    {city: city for city in CITIES if city != "Caerleon"},
    type=str,
)

app = FastAPI()


@app.get("/api/opportunities")
def get_opportunities(server: str = "Americas", premium: bool = False, max_age_min: float = 60):
    tax_pct = 4 if premium else 8
    try:
        raw_prices = fetch_prices(server, ITEM_IDS)
    except AodpFetchError as exc:
        return JSONResponse(status_code=502, content={"error": str(exc)})

    return compute_opportunities(raw_prices, ITEM_NAMES, tax_pct, max_age_min, ITEM_WEIGHTS)


@app.get("/api/cargo-plan")
def get_cargo_plan(
    city: TransportOrigin,
    budget: int = Query(..., gt=0),
    available_weight: float = Query(..., gt=0),
    server: str = "Americas",
    premium: bool = False,
    max_age_min: float = 60,
    max_qty_per_item: int = Query(5, gt=0),
):
    tax_pct = 4 if premium else 8
    try:
        raw_prices = fetch_prices(server, ITEM_IDS)
    except AodpFetchError as exc:
        return JSONResponse(status_code=502, content={"error": str(exc)})

    opportunities = compute_city_opportunities(
        raw_prices, ITEM_NAMES, tax_pct, max_age_min, city.value, ITEM_WEIGHTS
    )
    plan = optimize_cargo(opportunities, budget, available_weight, max_qty_per_item)

    if not opportunities:
        status = "no_opportunities"
    elif not plan["items"]:
        status = "no_item_fits"
    else:
        status = "ok"

    return {"status": status, **plan}


app.mount("/", StaticFiles(directory=str(BASE_DIR / "static"), html=True), name="static")
```

Note: the new test helper uses `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` —
`tests/test_main.py` already has `from datetime import datetime, timezone`
at the top from earlier work, so no new import is needed.

- [ ] **Step 4: Add Cargo Planner logic to `static/app.js`**

Append at the end of the file (before the final `loadOpportunities();`
call is fine to leave where it is — this is new, independent code):

```javascript
const cargoFmtInt = new Intl.NumberFormat("pt-BR", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 });

function setCargoStatus(text, kind) {
  const el = document.getElementById("cargoStatus");
  el.textContent = text;
  el.className = kind || "";
}

async function loadCargoPlan() {
  const server = document.getElementById("server").value;
  const premium = document.getElementById("premium").checked;
  const maxAge = document.getElementById("maxAge").value;
  const city = document.getElementById("cargoCity").value;
  const budget = document.getElementById("cargoBudget").value;
  const availableWeight = document.getElementById("cargoWeight").value;
  const maxQtyPerItem = document.getElementById("cargoMaxQty").value;
  const bankroll = document.getElementById("cargoBankroll").value;
  const cargoTable = document.getElementById("cargoTable");

  setCargoStatus("Montando carga…", "info");
  cargoTable.style.display = "none";

  const params = new URLSearchParams({
    server, premium, max_age_min: maxAge, city,
    budget, available_weight: availableWeight, max_qty_per_item: maxQtyPerItem,
  });

  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/cargo-plan?${params}`);
    if (!response.ok) {
      setCargoStatus("Não foi possível montar a carga.", "error");
      return;
    }
    const plan = await response.json();
    renderCargoPlan(plan, bankroll);
  } catch (err) {
    setCargoStatus("Não foi possível montar a carga.", "error");
  }
}

function renderCargoPlan(plan, bankroll) {
  const cargoTable = document.getElementById("cargoTable");

  if (plan.status === "no_opportunities") {
    setCargoStatus("Nenhuma oportunidade encontrada nessa cidade com esses filtros.", "error");
    return;
  }
  if (plan.status === "no_item_fits") {
    setCargoStatus("Existem oportunidades, mas nenhuma cabe no peso/capital informados.", "error");
    return;
  }

  setCargoStatus("", "");
  cargoTable.style.display = "";

  document.getElementById("cargoRows").innerHTML = plan.items.map(item => `
    <tr>
      <td>${item.item_name}</td>
      <td>${item.quantity}</td>
      <td>${cargoFmtInt.format(item.total_cost)}</td>
      <td>${item.total_weight}</td>
      <td>${cargoFmtInt.format(item.total_profit)}</td>
      <td>${item.roi_pct}%</td>
    </tr>
  `).join("");

  const t = plan.totals;
  let bankrollWarning = "";
  if (bankroll) {
    const pct = (t.capital_used / bankroll) * 100;
    if (pct > 20) {
      bankrollWarning = `<p class="error">Essa carga é ${pct.toFixed(1)}% do seu bankroll — acima da faixa recomendada de 10-20%.</p>`;
    }
  }

  document.getElementById("cargoTotals").innerHTML = `
    <p>Capital usado: ${cargoFmtInt.format(t.capital_used)} (restante: ${cargoFmtInt.format(t.capital_remaining)}, ${t.budget_utilization_pct}% usado)</p>
    <p>Peso usado: ${t.weight_used} kg (restante: ${t.weight_remaining} kg, ${t.weight_utilization_pct}% usado)</p>
    <p>Lucro estimado: ${cargoFmtInt.format(t.profit)} (ROI ${t.roi_pct}%)</p>
    <p>Restrição limitante: ${t.binding_constraint} — estratégia: ${t.strategy_used || "-"}</p>
    ${bankrollWarning}
  `;
}

document.getElementById("cargoSubmit").addEventListener("click", loadCargoPlan);
```
